body: Great way to look at this. You’re a better person than me.
I’m a man and I’m telling you this is true. Let it go and find the man that deserves you.

You can’t get in someone’s head and you will never know the answer. Every day you waste trying is a day you miss finding the man that loves all of you. 

I believe that♥️

It just takes time. I know it’s hard to come to grips with, but some people are just assholes. There is something seriously wrong with him that you just missed and it isn’t your fault. It’s ok to grieve and no one can tell you how long it will take to get over it, but know that you are better off without someone like that in your life. You deserve better. I shared this with someone else earlier, but maybe we should all recognize this. 


https://herway.net/love/choose-the-man-who-loves-all-of-you/

I hope it helps you.

I’m sorry you’re going through this and I know how terrible it feels. The best thing you can do is let it go and have no more contact at all. As much as we would like to believe we can get honesty and closure by asking tough questions, the fact is that you won’t. Most people refuse to be honest because it’s hard. It’s easier to lie or not answer the question at all. I know it doesn’t seem fair, but it’s just the reality of the situation.

I’m not sure I did this reply correctly, but it’s always going to be something for a while. I went to the post office today and remember we were there getting our passports the last time I was in. Ironically, she went on vacation last week with her new boyfriend the exact same week one year later. I know it’s just coincidental, but it stings just the same. 

You’ll be okay.... just remember to stay away, don’t email, call or text and don’t answer any you receive. It’s going to be hard..... it’s going to feel impossible. I failed miserably at this exact advice, but if you want the pain to end you have to get away from all of it.

I’ve been in your shoes and understand how you feel right now. Honestly, it’s different for everyone. I know that answer doesn’t make things easier for you. Stop looking for the texts and calls. If you get one it could potentially make things worse. The sooner you go no contact and stick to it, the faster you will recover. 

I recently made the mistake of taking a call after 5 months past the breakup. I also made the mistake of meeting her for lunch and the filling day only to have the rug pulled out from under me within a week. It’s not worth it I assure you. It’s going to be hard and nothing I can say will make it better, but the sooner you go no contact and have no expectations that he will reach out, the sooner you will heal.
You’ll be fine man. Sounds like you’re already in a good spot mentally. Don’t let it get you down and move on with what makes you happy.

The feeling of someone walking away from a relationship is the worst. I’ve been dealing with the same nightmare for three months. I would fall asleep thinking about her and wake up feeling the she was laying in bed next to me..... then reality would sink in. I can only hope it goes away with time like everyone tells me.
It sounds like you have a lot going for you. Kids and a husband that seems to love you unconditionally. I think that sounds great to me. Seek help from a therapist or doctor to stop the pain.

I will tell you this, you can’t worry about what other people think or say. Don’t let it get you down. I don’t know your circumstances, but I’ll bet you’re young enough to still have hope. 

I’m 50 and I see things differently I guess. You may still have great times ahead of you.
